mapping.note: only when tipoActo is 'Anúncio de procedimento'; an 'Anúncio de concurso urgente' gives no fact (the urgent tender is not in the vocabulary and modeloAnuncio still says 'Concurso público'); values outside the map give no fact
only when the list holds exactly one value; 'Locação de bens móveis', 'Outros', 'Sociedade', an empty list and lists of several types give no fact; servicos_sociais is not told apart by this field
EUR as the dump writes it: decimal point, two decimals, no thousands separator (e.g. '318231.43'); 'Inexistente' and '0.00' give no fact
nine digits; an empty value gives no fact
dd/mm/yyyy; the publication date of the notice, never used as the date the notice was sent nor as the start of the procedure
dd/mm/yyyy; empty, or earlier than dataPublicacao: no fact

record.key_note: unit and raw ids: nAnuncio with every run of characters outside [A-Za-z0-9] as '-', a dot, IdIncm ('-1', no DR id, as 'x'); a key held by two procedure records of the dump maps neither

unmapped_acts.Anúncio de Alteração: alters an earlier notice that the dump does not name; no field joins it to its procedure
unmapped_acts.Declaração de retificação de anúncio: rectifies an earlier notice that the dump does not name; no field joins it to its procedure

entities.type_note: the NIF's leading digits decide the type only where the code table is decisive (1, 2, 3, 45: natural person; 6: public administration body); 5 and 9 (legal persons, public or private) do not, and entidade.type has no value for that: no entidade is written for them (SCHEMA-PROPOSAL.md)

not_in_source.data_envio_anuncio: the dump has no sending date; dataPublicacao is the publication date and is not substituted for it
not_in_source.prazo_propostas_dias: PrazoPropostas is DataLimitePropostas minus dataPublicacao (equal in every record with both dates), so it counts from publication, not from the sending of the notice as the rules' counted_from requires; it gives no fact
not_in_source.data_inicio_procedimento: the dump has no start date of the procedure; the publication date is a later event and is not substituted for it
not_in_source.publicado_joue: no field of the dump says whether the notice was sent to the JOUE
not_in_source.territorio: no field of the dump gives the territory
not_in_source.tipo_entidade: no field of the dump says whether the contracting entity is the State
